html: Both RFCs opened for comment, with a window of 7 September to 17 October 2026 and an issue each as the comment thread: RFC 0001, the construct-domain code list at v0.2, five admissions, two new fields on every code and a mapping from the question bank's topic groups; and RFC 0002, whether a construct about an identified person, such as a manager rated by their team, enters the vocabulary at all, and under what rule. The aggregation floors protect respondents and do nothing for subjects, and RFC 0002 gates RFC 0001: no subject-identifying code is admitted until it is settled.
